additional_info.subject: SiChargeD 170000127 does not communicate since 08.11.2024
additional_info.body:
Customer states the SiCharge D station does not communicate with the server from 08.11.2024.
The charger responds to pings but does not communicate. He asks Siemens to check remotely in its backend logs for the cause of this issue and how can it be fixed.
The serial number of the charger is 170000127

Otherwise you need to go there and do it yourself. We take the time to understand the root cause if you go there.

For future reference, your ticket number is
0389233
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
